title: Policy index linking clauses to controls
recommendation: Create a policies/ index in which every policy clause links to an Echelon control ID (ECTL-*) and carries an explicit status of in-force or target.
rationale: Prevents template policies from asserting unperformed practices and makes policy compliance checkable.

title: Draft the P0 policy set
recommendation: Draft P01, P02 (adopt the corrected Secure Construction Standard), P03, P04, P05, P06, P14, P15, P18, P26, P30 and P32; P09 before any donor data is processed.
rationale: These are the documents nearly every financial-services questionnaire requests and none exists.

title: Counsel determination on GLBA and FTC Safeguards Rule status
recommendation: Obtain a counsel determination whether Echelon Foundry or the Unbound operating entity is a financial institution under GLBA and the FTC Safeguards Rule (OQ-DD-POL-001), and whether Unbound would be a bank service provider under the 2021 incident notification rule (OQ-DD-POL-002).
rationale: The answer converts several policies from optional to mandatory and fixes notification timelines.

title: Generate registers from data
recommendation: Generate the subprocessor list, asset inventory and vendor register from structured data with review dates rather than maintain them as prose documents.
rationale: Continuously current registers are cheaper and more credible than periodically updated documents.

title: No unedited template policy packs
recommendation: Do not adopt purchased template policy packs without editing every clause to match operating reality and marking target-state clauses.
rationale: A false policy statement is worse than a missing policy: it creates misrepresentation exposure and audit exceptions.
